sub_service: New water connection, water tanker booking, manhole/gully grating replacement
problem_type: New water connection request, need for water tanker, missing manhole cover or gully grating
description: NDMC's own published SLA Timeline page gives real, numeric day-limits for water-related service requests. This is a genuinely separate civic authority from Delhi's MCD (which governs the rest of Delhi) -- NDMC governs only the New Delhi/Lutyens' Delhi area.
procedure: Submit request via NDMC's online portal, NDMC 311 app, or toll-free helpline 1533.
sla: New Water Connection (domestic): 35 days. Booking of Water Tankers/Trolleys: 1 day. Replacement of missing manhole covers, gully gratings: 2 days. Replacement of missing/broken fixtures: 7 days. Repair of Bell Mouths: 7 days.
contact_information: Toll-free: 1533. Control Room (Water Tankers): 011-23743642. Email: care@ndmc.gov.in.
escalation_procedure: NOT FOUND IN OFFICIAL SOURCE on this page.

description: NDMC's published SLA Timeline gives real numeric day-limits for road-related service requests. Does not cover routine pothole-repair complaints specifically -- only obstruction removal and road-cutting permission are listed with SLAs on this page.
procedure: Submit request via NDMC's online portal, NDMC 311 app, or toll-free helpline 1533.
sla: Removal of any obstruction on road: 1 day. Road Cutting Permission: 7 days.
